{{Short description|none}}
The prolific [[mathematician]] [[Paul Erdős]] and his various collaborators made many mathematical [[conjecture]]s across subjects, and in many cases Erdős offered monetary rewards for solving them.

The unsolved problems are commonly known as [[Paul Erdős#Erdős's problems|Erdős problems]].

==Unsolved==
* The [[Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture]] on cycles with lengths equal to a power of two in graphs with minimum degree 3.
* The [[Erdős–Hajnal conjecture]] that in a family of graphs defined by an excluded induced subgraph, every graph has either a large clique or a large independent set.<ref>{{citation
 | last1 = Erdős | first1 = P. | author1-link = Paul Erdős
 | last2 = Hajnal | first2 = A. | author2-link = András Hajnal
 | department = Combinatorics and complexity (Chicago, IL, 1987)
 | doi = 10.1016/0166-218X(89)90045-0
 | issue = 1–2
 | journal = [[Discrete Applied Mathematics]]
 | mr = 1031262
 | pages = 37–52
 | title = Ramsey-type theorems
 | volume = 25
 | year = 1989| doi-access = free
 }}.</ref>
* The [[Powerful number|Erdős–Mollin–Walsh conjecture]] on consecutive triples of powerful numbers.
* The Erdős–Selfridge conjecture that a [[covering system]] with distinct moduli contains at least one even modulus.
* The [[Erdős–Straus conjecture]] on the Diophantine equation 4/''n'' = 1/''x'' + 1/''y'' + 1/''z''.
* The [[Erdős conjecture on arithmetic progressions]] in sequences with divergent sums of reciprocals.
* The [[Erdős–Szekeres conjecture]] on the number of points needed to ensure that a point set contains a large convex polygon.
* The [[Erdős–Turán conjecture on additive bases]] of natural numbers.
* A conjecture on [[Sylvester's sequence|quickly growing integer sequences with rational reciprocal series]].
* A conjecture with Norman Oler<ref>{{citation
 | last = Oler | first = Norman
 | doi = 10.4153/CMB-1961-018-7
 | mr = 0133065
 | journal = [[Canadian Mathematical Bulletin]]
 | pages = 153–155
 | title = A finite packing problem
 | volume = 4
 | year = 1961| issue = 2
 | doi-access = free
 }}.</ref> on [[circle packing in an equilateral triangle]] with a number of circles one less than a [[triangular number]].
* The [[minimum overlap problem]] to estimate the limit of ''M''(''n'').
* A conjecture that the ternary expansion of <math>2^n</math> contains at least one digit 2 for every <math>n > 8</math>.<ref>{{cite journal
 | last = Lagarias | first = Jeffrey C. | author-link = Jeffrey Lagarias
 | doi = 10.1112/jlms/jdn080
 | issue = 3
 | journal = [[Journal of the London Mathematical Society]]
 | mr = 2506687
 | pages = 562–588
 | series = Second Series
 | title = Ternary expansions of powers of 2
 | date = 2009 | volume = 79
 | arxiv = math/0512006
 | s2cid = 15615918 }}</ref>
* The conjecture that the [[Erdős–Moser equation]], {{math|1=1<sup>''k''</sup> + 2<sup>''k''</sup> + &ctdot; + (''m'' − 1)<sup>''k''</sup> = ''m''<sup>''k''</sup>}}, has no solutions except {{math|1=1<sup>1</sup> + 2<sup>1</sup> = 3<sup>1</sup>}}.

==Solved==
* The [[Erdős–Faber–Lovász conjecture]] on coloring unions of cliques, proved (for all large n) by Dong Yeap Kang, Tom Kelly, [[Daniela Kühn]], Abhishek Methuku, and [[Deryk Osthus]] in 2021.<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/mathematicians-settle-erdos-coloring-conjecture-20210405/|title=Mathematicians Settle Erdős Coloring Conjecture|last=Houston-Edwards|first=Kelsey|website=[[Quanta Magazine]]|date=5 April 2021 |language=en|access-date=2021-04-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 | last1 =  Kang | first1 = Dong Yeap
 | last2 =  Kelly | first2 = Tom
 | last3 =  Kühn | first3 = Daniela | author3-link = Daniela Kühn
 | last4 =  Methuku | first4 = Abhishek
 | last5 =  Osthus | first5 = Deryk | author5-link = Deryk Osthus
 | journal = [[Annals of Mathematics]]
 | mr = 4635300
 | zbl = 
 | pages = 537–618
 | title = A proof of the Erdős–Faber–Lovász conjecture
 | date = 2023
 | volume = 198
 | issue = 2
 | doi = 10.4007/annals.2023.198.2.2
 | arxiv = 2101.04698
 | s2cid = 261437786
 }}.</ref>
* The [[Erdős sumset conjecture]] on sets, proven by Joel Moreira, Florian Karl Richter and Donald Robertson in 2018. The proof appeared in the [[Annals of Mathematics]] journal in March 2019.<ref>{{cite journal
 | last1 =  Moreira | first1 = J.
 | last2 =  Richter | first2 = F. K.
 | last3 =  Robertson | first3 = D.
 | journal = [[Annals of Mathematics]]
 | mr = 3919363
 | zbl = 1407.05236
 | pages = 605–652
 | title = A proof of a sumset conjecture of Erdős 
 | date = 2019
 | volume = 189
 | issue = 2
 | doi = 10.4007/annals.2019.189.2.4  | arxiv = 1803.00498
 | s2cid = 119158401
 }}.</ref>
* The [[Burr–Erdős conjecture]] on Ramsey numbers of graphs, proved by Choongbum Lee in 2015.<ref>{{citation|first=Gil|last=Kalai|author-link=Gil Kalai|title=Choongbum Lee proved the Burr–Erdős conjecture|work=Combinatorics and more|url=https://gilkalai.wordpress.com/2015/05/22/choongbum-lee-proved-the-burr-erdos-conjecture/|date=May 22, 2015|access-date=2015-05-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=Ramsey numbers of degenerate graphs|first=Choongbum|last=Lee|doi = 10.4007/annals.2017.185.3.2 | issue = 3 | journal = Annals of Mathematics |date=2017 | pages = 791–829 | volume = 185 |arxiv=1505.04773|s2cid=7974973 }}</ref>
* A conjecture on [[equitable coloring]]s proven in 1970 by [[András Hajnal]] and [[Endre Szemerédi]] and now known as the [[Hajnal–Szemerédi theorem]].<ref>{{citation|contribution=Proof of a conjecture of P. Erdős|first1=A.|last1=Hajnal|author1-link=András Hajnal|first2=E.|last2=Szemerédi|author2-link=Endre Szemerédi|title=Combinatorial theory and its applications, II (Proc. Colloq., Balatonfüred, 1969)|publisher=North-Holland|year=1970|pages=601–623|mr=0297607}}.</ref>
* A conjecture that would have strengthened the [[Furstenberg–Sárközy theorem]] to state that the number of elements in a square-difference-free set of positive integers could only exceed the square root of its largest value by a polylogarithmic factor, disproved by [[András Sárközy]] in 1978.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Sárközy | first = A. | author-link = András Sárközy
 | journal = Annales Universitatis Scientiarum Budapestinensis de Rolando Eötvös Nominatae
 | mr = 536201
 | pages = 45–53 (1979)
 | title = On difference sets of sequences of integers. II
 | volume = 21
 | year = 1978}}.</ref>
* The [[Erdős–Lovász conjecture]] on weak/strong [[delta system|delta-systems]], proved by [[Michel Deza]] in 1974.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Deza | first = M. | author-link = Michel Deza
 | doi = 10.1016/0095-8956(74)90059-8
 | journal = [[Journal of Combinatorial Theory]]
 | language = French
 | mr = 0337635
 | pages = 166–167
 | series = Series B
 | title = Solution d'un problème de Erdős–Lovász
 | volume = 16
 | issue = 2 | year = 1974| doi-access = free
 }}.</ref>
* The [[Restricted sumset|Erdős–Heilbronn conjecture]] in combinatorial number theory on the number of sums of two sets of residues modulo a prime, proved by Dias da Silva and Hamidoune in 1994.<ref>{{citation
 | last1 = da Silva | first1 = Dias
 | last2 = A. | first2 = J.
 | last3 = Hamidoune | first3 = Y. O.
 | doi = 10.1112/blms/26.2.140
 | issue = 2
 | journal = [[Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society]]
 | pages = 140–146
 | title = Cyclic spaces for Grassmann derivatives and additive theory
 | volume = 26
 | year = 1994}}.</ref>
* The [[Erdős–Graham conjecture]] in combinatorial number theory on monochromatic Egyptian fraction representations of unity, proved by [[Ernie Croot]] in 2000.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Croot | first = Ernest S. III | author-link = Ernest S. Croot III
 | publisher = [[University of Georgia]], Athens
 | series = Ph.D. thesis
 | title = Unit Fractions
 | year = 2000}}. {{cite journal
 | last = Croot | first = Ernest S. III | author-link = Ernest S. Croot III
 | arxiv = math.NT/0311421
 | doi = 10.4007/annals.2003.157.545
 | issue = 2
 | journal = [[Annals of Mathematics]]
 | pages = 545–556
 | title = On a coloring conjecture about unit fractions
 | date = 2003 | volume = 157
 | bibcode = 2003math.....11421C | s2cid = 13514070 }}.</ref>
* The [[Erdős–Stewart conjecture]] on the [[Diophantine equation]] ''n''!&nbsp;+&nbsp;1&nbsp;=&nbsp;''p''<sub>''k''</sub><sup>''a''</sup>&nbsp;''p''<sub>''k''+1</sub><sup>''b''</sup>, solved by [[Florian Luca]] in 2001.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Luca | first = Florian
 | doi = 10.1090/S0025-5718-00-01178-9
 | issue = 234
 | journal = [[Mathematics of Computation]]
 | mr = 1677411
 | pages = 893–896
 | title = On a conjecture of Erdős and Stewart
 | volume = 70
 | year = 2001| bibcode = 2001MaCom..70..893L
 | doi-access = free
 }}.</ref>
* The [[Cameron–Erdős conjecture]] on sum-free sets of integers, proved by [[Ben J. Green|Ben Green]] and Alexander Sapozhenko in 2003–2004.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Sapozhenko | first = A. A.
 | issue = 6
 | journal = Doklady Akademii Nauk
 | mr = 2088503
 | pages = 749–752
 | title = The Cameron–Erdős conjecture
 | volume = 393
 | year = 2003}}. {{cite journal
 | last = Green | first = Ben | author-link = Ben J. Green
 | arxiv = math.NT/0304058
 | doi = 10.1112/S0024609304003650
 | issue = 6
 | journal = [[Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society]]
 | mr = 2083752
 | pages = 769–778
 | title = The Cameron–Erdős conjecture
 | date = 2004 | volume = 36
 | s2cid = 119615076 }}.</ref>
* The [[Erdős–Menger conjecture]] on disjoint paths in infinite graphs, proved by [[Ron Aharoni]] and Eli Berger in 2009.<ref>{{cite journal
 | last1 = Aharoni | first1 = Ron | author1-link = Ron Aharoni
 | last2 = Berger | first2 = Eli
 | doi = 10.1007/s00222-008-0157-3
 | journal = [[Inventiones Mathematicae]]
 | pages = 1–62
 | title = Menger's Theorem for infinite graphs
 | date = 2009 | volume = 176
 | issue = 1 | arxiv = math/0509397| bibcode = 2009InMat.176....1A| s2cid = 15355399 }}.</ref>
* The [[Erdős distinct distances problem]]. The correct exponent was proved in 2010 by [[Larry Guth]] and [[Nets Katz]], but the correct power of log&nbsp;''n'' is still undetermined.<ref>{{cite journal
| first1=Larry | last1=Guth | author-link1=Larry Guth
| first2=Nets H. | last2=Katz | author-link2=Nets Katz
| arxiv=1011.4105
| title=On the Erdős distinct distances problem in the plane
| journal=Annals of Mathematics
| series=Second series
| date=2015 | pages=155–190
| volume=181
| issue=1
| doi=10.4007/annals.2015.181.1.2 | doi-access=free}}.</ref>
* The [[Cramer's conjecture#Conditional proven results on prime gaps|Erdős–Rankin conjecture]] on prime gaps, proved by [[Kevin Ford (mathematician)|Ford]], [[Ben J. Green|Green]], [[Sergei Konyagin|Konyagin]], and [[Terence Tao|Tao]] in 2014.<ref>{{cite journal
| last1=Ford | first1=Kevin | author1-link=Kevin Ford (mathematician)
| last2=Green | first2=Ben | author2-link=Ben J. Green
| last3=Konyagin | first3=Sergei | author3-link=Sergei Konyagin
| last4=Tao | first4=Terence | author4-link=Terence Tao
| title=Large gaps between consecutive prime numbers
| journal=Annals of Mathematics
| series=Second series
| date=2016
| volume=183
| issue=3
| pages=935–974
| doi=10.4007/annals.2016.183.3.4 | doi-access=free| arxiv=1408.4505
}}</ref>
* The [[Erdős discrepancy problem]] on partial sums of ±1-sequences. [[Terence Tao]] announced a solution in September 2015; it was published in 2016.<ref>{{cite journal|title=The Erdős discrepancy problem|first=Terence|last=Tao|author-link=Terence Tao|year=2016|arxiv=1509.05363|doi=10.19086/da.609|journal=[[Discrete Analysis]]|pages=1–29|mr=3533300|s2cid=59361755 |issn=2397-3129}}</ref>
* The [[Erdős squarefree conjecture]] that central binomial coefficients C(2''n'', ''n'') are never squarefree for ''n'' > 4 was proved in 1996 by [[Olivier Ramaré]] and [[Andrew Granville]].<ref>{{citation
| last = Sárközy | first = A. | author-link = András Sárközy
| doi = 10.1016/0022-314X(85)90017-4 | doi-access=free
| issue = 1
| journal = Journal of Number Theory
| mr = 777971
| pages = 70–80
| title = On divisors of binomial coefficients. I
| volume = 20
| year = 1985}}</ref><ref>{{citation
| last1=Ramaré | first1=Olivier | last2=Granville | first2=Andrew
| title=Explicit bounds on exponential sums and the scarcity of squarefree binomial coefficients
| journal=[[Mathematika]]
| volume=43
| date=1996
| issue=1
| pages=73–107
| doi=10.1112/S0025579300011608|author-link=Olivier Ramaré|author-link2=Andrew Granville}}</ref>
* The [[Erdős primitive set conjecture]] that the sum <math>\sum_{n\in A}\frac{1}{n\log n}</math> for any primitive set A (a set where no member of the set divides another member) attains its maximum at the set of prime numbers, proved by Jared Duker Lichtman in 2022.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Lichtman |first=Jared Duker |date=2023 |title=A proof of the Erdős primitive set conjecture |journal=Forum of Mathematics, Pi |volume=11 |article-number=e18 |doi=10.1017/fmp.2023.16 |arxiv=2202.02384 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Cepelewicz |first=Jordana |date=2022-06-06 |title=Graduate Student's Side Project Proves Prime Number Conjecture |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/graduate-students-side-project-proves-prime-number-conjecture-20220606/ |access-date=2022-06-06 |website=Quanta Magazine |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.numberphile.com/videos/primes-and-primitive-sets |title=Primes and Primitive Sets |last=Haran |first=Brady |website=[[Numberphile]] |date=16 June 2022 |access-date=2022-06-21 }}</ref>
* The [[Erdős–Sauer problem]] about the maximum number of edges an n-vertex graph can have without containing a k-[[Regular graph|regular]] subgraph, was solved by Oliver Janzer and [[Benny Sudakov]].<ref>{{cite arXiv |last1=Janzer |first1=Oliver |last2=Sudakov |first2=Benny |author2-link=Benny Sudakov |date=2022-04-26 |title=Resolution of the Erdős–Sauer problem on regular subgraphs |class=math.CO |eprint=2204.12455}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-06-23 |title=New Proof Shows When Structure Must Emerge in Graphs |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/new-proof-shows-when-structure-must-emerge-in-graphs-20220623/ |access-date=2022-06-26 |website=Quanta Magazine |language=en}}</ref>
* Terence Tao reported that [[Erdős problem 728]] was solved in 2026 using AI assistance.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-07 |title=Terence Tao (@tao@mathstodon.xyz) |url=https://mathstodon.xyz/@tao/115855840223258103 |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=Mathstodon |language=en}}</ref> The proof was constructed in the [[Lean (proof assistant)|Lean proof language]] by Kevin Barreto and Liam Price with the assistance of [[GPT-5.2|ChatGPT 5.2]] and the [[Aristotle Lean API]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Erdős Problem #728 |url=https://www.erdosproblems.com/728 |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=www.erdosproblems.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite arXiv |last=Sothanaphan |first=Nat |title=Resolution of Erdős Problem #728: a writeup of Aristotle's Lean proof |date=2026-01-15 |class=math.NT |eprint=2601.07421}}</ref>
* [[Erdős problem 347]] on the subset sums of sequences with ratio limit 2 was proved in January 2026 by Enrique Barschkis; the proof was formally verified in the [[Lean (proof assistant)|Lean]] proof assistant.<ref>{{cite web |title=Erdős Problem #347 |url=https://www.erdosproblems.com/347 |website=Erdős Problems |access-date=2026-02-17}}</ref>
* In March 2026, Erdős problem 369 was solved by 17-year-old Sky Yang (Yueer Yang), and the result was later proven correct after verification in Lean.<ref>{{cite web |title=Erdős Problem #369 |url=https://www.erdosproblems.com/369 |website=ErdosProblems.com |access-date=2026-04-01}}</ref> 
* Erdős problem 90, the [[Unit distance graph|planar unit distance problem]], was solved by an internal [[OpenAI]] model in May 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |title=90 {{!}} Erdős Problems |url=https://www.erdosproblems.com/90 |access-date=2026-05-21 |website=www.erdosproblems.com}}</ref>
